blurb: Guests can zipline through forest canopy on seven ziplines and three swinging bridges, enjoy a kids-specific zipline course, take blacksmithing classes, climb a 65-foot wall, meet animals, or join multi-day kids camps. Activities cater to various ages and skill levels with professional guides and safety equipment. The park is located in Awendaw, near Charleston, SC.
